summary: Take a term γ₀ in the block; its big-cell decomposition γ₀ = v·w_m·σ·v' gives σ (floor group) and t = Z(σ)_{top,top} ≠ 0; the parameterization δ(p, u, u') = u·w_{(p,t)}σ·u'⁻¹ is injective, maps every parameter into termsOfLink(Λ) and has every term of the block in its image, while membership in termsOver(c, s, c') is still tested by an indicator (a parameter need not have the prescribed reduction); summing over (p, u, u') and grouping by p gives L(p), and dominated convergence gives the limits of the coset amplitudes.

steps.claim: A term γ₀ of the block: γ₀ ∈ termsOfLink(Λ) ∩ termsOver(c, s, c') (𝗀(γ₀) ≠ 0 and link Λ), since the amplitude sum is nonzero, the sum over an empty set would be 0.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨γ₀, ⟨h₀, l⟩, h⟩ := not_isEmpty_iff.1 (h ∘ by apply @tsum_empty)

steps.claim: Big-cell decomposition of γ₀ (all leading minors nonzero, hs): γ₀ = v⁻¹·(weylElem(ϱ, m)·σ)·v' with v, v' ∈ 𝖴 and σ ∈ GT(ϱ).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨v, m, v', n, r, σ, hσ, e⟩ := exists_big_cell_decomp (hs _ h)

steps.claim: L: Λ = link(weylElem(ϱ, p)·σ) for every p (link is invariant under 𝖴 on both sides, link_besselU_mul, and does not depend on p, link_big_cell_eq_iff).
steps.lean:
have L p : Λ = link (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ p * σ) :=
    l ▸ by simp [link_besselU_mul, link_big_cell_eq_iff, *]

steps.claim: The top leading minor of the decomposed γ₀ is nonzero;
rewrite through the invariance of minors and 𝗀 under 𝖴 and Weyl elements.
steps.lean:
simp [-sub_eq_zero, frameDisc_frameGram_besselU_mul, ↓leadingMinor_frameGram_besselU_mul,
    ↓frameDisc_weylElem_mul hσ, ↓frameGram_weylElem_mul hσ, leadingMinor, *] at T h₀

steps.claim: t = Z(σ)(top, top), a unit (nonzero by the top leading minor).

steps.lean:
let δ (i : (Fin 𝔰.ϱ → _) × besselU × besselU) :=
    i.2.1.1 * (weylElem 𝔰.ϱ (padTuple i.1 t) * σ) * i.2.2.1⁻¹

steps.claim: A: δ is injective (big-cell uniqueness), and its image contains every term of the block (steps 10–12); so the amplitude times the indicator of the block termsOfLink(Λ) ∩ termsOver(c, s, c'), composed with δ, has the same sum as the block. The indicator stays: δ(i) lies in termsOfLink(Λ) for every parameter (D), but a parameter need not have the prescribed reduction s, so membership in termsOver(c, s, c') is still tested.
steps.lean:
have A : HasSum ((S.termsOfLink Λ ∩ S.termsOver c s c').indicator (S.amplitude c c') ∘ δ) _ :=
    (Injective.hasSum_iff (fun _ _ ↦
    (by simpa [Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, padTuple] using big_cell_unique hσ ·))
    fun γ n ↦ ite_eq_right fun o ↦ ?_).2 (hasSum_subtype_iff_indicator.1
      (summable_amplitude ..).hasSum)
steps.typed_fact: HasSum ((S.termsOfLink Λ ∩ S.termsOver c s c').indicator (S.amplitude c c') ∘ δ) _

steps.claim: D: every δ(i) lies in termsOfLink(Λ).
steps.lean:
· have D i : δ i ∈ S.termsOfLink Λ := by simp [δ, termsOfLink]; rw [← inv_inv i.2.1.1, termDisc,
      frameDisc_frameGram_besselU_mul, link_besselU_mul,
      frameDisc_weylElem_mul] <;> simp [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, ← L, *]
    refine ⟨t, σ, _, ⟨hσ, rfl, fun v ↦ by simpa [mul_conj', sq] using! (((map_ne_zero (Φ v)).2
      h₀.2).lt_of_le' ((termPosition_floorGroup_spec hσ c
      c').2.2.1 ▸ by simp [dotProduct, conj_mul']; positivity)).1,
      h.choose_spec.1, L _⟩, _, A.prod_fiberwise (A.summable.prod_factor · |>.hasSum), fun p ↦
      tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence (A.summable.prod_factor p).norm (fun q ↦
      tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ((S.eventually_isIntegralOff (S.termPosition c c q.1)).mono ?_))
      (.of_forall fun _ q ↦ ?_)⟩ <;> clear * - D <;> grind -ac [indicator, D (p, q), norm_zero]

steps.claim: Choose t, σ, k; N² < |Φ_v(t)|² from the norm identity of termPosition_floorGroup_spec; L(p) the sum over (u, u') with fixed p (fibres of A); the limits by dominated convergence, eventually integral off T.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨t, σ, _, ⟨hσ, rfl, fun v ↦ by simpa [mul_conj', sq] using! (((map_ne_zero (Φ v)).2
      h₀.2).lt_of_le' ((termPosition_floorGroup_spec hσ c
      c').2.2.1 ▸ by simp [dotProduct, conj_mul']; positivity)).1,
      h.choose_spec.1, L _⟩, _, A.prod_fiberwise (A.summable.prod_factor · |>.hasSum), fun p ↦
      tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence (A.summable.prod_factor p).norm (fun q ↦
      tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ((S.eventually_isIntegralOff (S.termPosition c c q.1)).mono ?_))
      (.of_forall fun _ q ↦ ?_)⟩ <;> clear * - D <;> grind -ac [indicator, D (p, q), norm_zero]

steps.claim: Surjectivity of δ onto the block: a term decomposes as w·w_pτ·w';
steps.lean: obtain ⟨w, hw, w', hw', p, τ, hτ, rfl⟩ := exists_big_cell_decomp (hs _ o.2)

steps.claim: its link equals Λ = link(w_1σ), so τ = σ (link_big_cell_eq_iff);
steps.lean: cases (link_big_cell_eq_iff hτ hσ).1 (L 1 ▸ link_besselU_mul hw hw' ▸ o.1.2)

steps.claim: so the term is δ((p_a)_a, w⁻¹, w'⁻¹) (padTuple; the Weyl elements agree entrywise), contradicting its exclusion from the image.
steps.lean:
exact n ⟨((p ·), ⟨w, hw⟩⁻¹,
    ⟨w', hw'⟩⁻¹), by simp [δ]; ext; simp [weylElem, weylOn, padTuple]; grind⟩
